description: Source code for handling character maps (cmap) in FreeType's PFR font rendering, including initialization, cleanup, character indexing, and character iteration functions.

methods.name: pfr_cmap_init
methods.description: Initializes a PFR character map with font data, verifying character entries are sorted.

methods.name: pfr_cmap_done
methods.description: Cleans up a PFR character map.

methods.name: pfr_cmap_char_index
methods.description: Finds the index of a character code within the cmap using binary search.

methods.name: pfr_cmap_char_next
methods.description: Finds the next character code after a given code in the cmap.
